test_fine_tune_model: test the FineTuner.fine_tune_model method to verify a global model is correctly fine-tuned with client data
test_fine_tune_and_evaluate: test the FineTuner.fine_tune_and_evaluate method to verify fine-tuning and evaluation across multiple clients
create_fake_data: create fake training data using TestFineTuner._fake_data with specified num_batches and batch_size parameters
create_model_with_value: create a SampleNet model filled with a specific value using TestFineTuner._get_model
run_fine_tuner_tests: run the TestFineTuner test suite to validate fine-tuning and evaluation functionality in FLSim
